## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For runtime changes, include the platform, OS, configuration, and simulator or device. Note any checks you could not run and why.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, with relevant tests and documentation updated.
- [ ] I checked the change for credentials, personal paths, private report contents, and other sensitive data.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the project license, and identified any external source or separate license in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

For a vulnerability, use [private reporting](https://github.com/matteozajac/MZAppFoundation/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of a public pull request.
